fix(common): emit the intake configuration schemas through named types

## Summary

TypeScript declaration emit prints an inferred Zod type in full wherever it is used. Two schemas in `packages/common/src/api-schemas/store.ts` multiplied their size this way:

- `InteractionExecutionConfigurationSchema` (which carries `model_options`) is embedded 8 times in `ContentTypeIntakePolicySchema`, and also in event and view schemas.
- `ContentTypeIntakePolicySchema` is embedded in every content-type schema (create/update payloads, catalog entries, items, in-code definitions).

So each content-type schema's declaration repeated the full model-options union 8 times. `store.d.ts` reached 3.8 MB, and `CONTENT_TYPE_AUTHORING_SCHEMAS` in `registry.ts` came close to TypeScript's serialization limit: adding one nested model option made the build fail with TS7056.

- Both schemas are now exported through interfaces (`InteractionExecutionConfigurationSchemaType`, `ContentTypeIntakePolicySchemaType`) that extend exactly their inferred type via Zod's `z.core.util.Identity`, so declaration emit references them by name. The schema bodies are unchanged. Types, runtime schemas, generated contracts and wire types are unchanged.
- `store.declarations.test.ts` compiles a small consumer that embeds both schemas and checks that its published declaration names both types instead of printing their fields. It fails if either annotation is removed.
- The `tsc` launch lives in `packages/common/test/declaration-emit.ts`, a test-only module outside `src` (so the build and the npm package never include it), added to `tsconfig.test.json`. vertesia/composableai#2805 reuses it, so **this PR must merge first**.

Declaration output of `@vertesia/common` (`tsc --emitDeclarationOnly`, current `main`):

| | `main` | this PR | with vertesia/llumiverse#861 and vertesia/composableai#2805 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api-schemas/store.d.ts` | 3.8 MB | 57 KB | 25 KB |
| All declarations | 20.7 MB | 8.3 MB | 3.0 MB |

This is independent of vertesia/llumiverse#861, which gives the model-options union itself a named type, and vertesia/composableai#2805, which stops `registry.d.ts` re-emitting every schema.

| | LOC (+/-) |
|---|---|
| Code | +14 / -2 |
| Tests | +87 / -0 (including the 56-line shared helper) |
| Config | +2 / -0 |
| Docs | 0 |

## Test Plan

- [x] `cd packages/common && pnpm lint`: no findings
- [x] `pnpm --filter @vertesia/common build`
- [x] `cd packages/common && pnpm typecheck:test`
- [x] `cd packages/common && pnpm test`: 67 files, 1370 tests pass. This includes the new declaration test, which also fails as intended when an annotation is removed, and the existing exact-type assertion against `ContentTypeIntakePolicySchema`.
- [x] `pnpm gen:schemas`: no diff in `components.generated.json`, `intake-policy-schema.generated.ts` or `wire-types.generated.ts`
- [x] Combined with vertesia/llumiverse#861 and an extra nested option added to `OpenAiImageGenerationOptionsSchema`, which previously reproduced TS7056: the build passes.

fix(common): emit ModelOptionsSchema through a named type

## Summary

`ModelOptionsSchema` was an inferred `z.ZodUnion` of every option schema. TypeScript declaration emit cannot refer to an inferred type by name, so every package that embeds the union in its own schemas printed all of its members again in its `.d.ts`, once per embedding. Declaration size grew with (number of embeddings) × (size of the union), so each new model or option made it larger. A downstream package (`@vertesia/common`) now fails with TS7056 ("The inferred type of this node exceeds the maximum length the compiler will serialize") when one more nested option is added.

- The union is built as before, as `modelOptionsSchema`, and exported as `ModelOptionsSchema` through `ModelOptionsSchemaType`, an interface that extends exactly its inferred type via Zod's `z.core.util.Identity`. Declaration emit always refers to an interface by name, so consumers emit one reference however large the union becomes.
- Types are unchanged: `z.infer`, `ModelOptions`, `.options` and each member's `.shape` keep their exact types. The runtime schema and its JSON Schema output are identical.
- `model-options.declarations.test.ts` compiles a small consumer that embeds the union and checks that its published declaration names `ModelOptionsSchemaType` instead of printing the members. A type-level check cannot do this, because the interface and the union are the same type to the checker. The test fails if the annotation is removed. `common/tsconfig.test.json` gains `"types": ["node"]` for it; `@types/node` was already a dev dependency, and the runtime build config is unchanged.

Declaration output of `@vertesia/common` built against this change (its current `main`, `tsc --emitDeclarationOnly`):

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `api-schemas/store.d.ts` | 3.8 MB | 189 KB |
| All declarations | 20.7 MB | 5.0 MB |

| | LOC (+/-) |
|---|---|
| Code | +7 / -1 |
| Tests | +62 / -0 |
| Config | +2 / -1 |
| Docs | 0 |

## Test Plan

- [x] Lint: `biome lint src` and `biome format src` (Biome 2.6.3) on `common`, no findings. Run with the parent workspace's Biome, because `pnpm lint` (`pnpm exec biome lint`) cannot find Biome in a submodule checkout without its own install.
- [x] `pnpm --filter @llumiverse/common build`, `@llumiverse/core build`, `@llumiverse/drivers build`. The root `pnpm build` (turbo) could not run in this checkout: it fails to parse `turbo.json` with the parent workspace's turbo version.
- [x] `cd common && pnpm typecheck:test`
- [x] `cd drivers && pnpm typecheck:test`
- [x] `cd common && pnpm exec vitest run`: 17 files, 729 tests pass, including the new declaration test. That test also fails as intended when the annotation is removed.
- [x] `cd drivers && pnpm exec vitest run --exclude '**/*.live.test.ts'`: 87 files, 1443 passed, 17 skipped
- [x] Downstream: `@vertesia/common` build, `typecheck:test` and tests pass against this change. With an extra nested option added to `OpenAiImageGenerationOptionsSchema`, which previously reproduced TS7056, the build also passes.

Fix the clippy failure in nekko-remote's phone channel guard

Closes #1945.

Since #1802, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` fails on `main` (pinned 1.96.0 toolchain) on `crates/nekko-remote/src/phone.rs`: `!args[0].as_str().is_some_and(|s| !s.is_empty())` is `nonminimal_bool`. This writes it as clippy suggests, `args[0].as_str().is_none_or(|s| s.is_empty())`. Same behavior: a missing, non-string or empty session id is still refused.

The daemon job runs clippy before the tests, so this stops every nightly run and every PR labelled `deploy:<os>`.

`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all -- --check`: clean.

No visual change, no spec change.

## Unfinished work / release blockers

None.

Update developer-policy to allow cloudquery to populate aws_iam_roles table

## What does this change?
This updates the policy used when running the service catalogue locally, allowing cloudquery to get and list IAM roles so that it can populate the aws_iam_roles table for testing purposes.

## Why has this change been made?
To allow testing of updates to the aws_iam_roles table so that an issue with the data not being overwritten each time the job runs can be addressed.
